Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.in
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo recap — Redwood for NorthBeam

Hi Jared / Emily,

Thanks again for the time today — good to learn more about NorthBeam's realtime attribution stack and the latency/cost pain you see when running batch scoring and ad-hoc experiments.

Recap / where we landed:
- Primary goal: reduce per-query cost for online scoring and enable low-latency feature enrichment for real-time cohorts.
- Key constraints: existing infra (GKE + internal KMS), strict audit trail requirements, peak throughput bursts during campaign launches.
- Success metrics: 40% token cost reduction vs current setup, P95 latency < 120ms for 512-token window, SU of secure audit logs.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (short deck), northbeam-mandate-questions.xlsx (infrastructure checklist)

Suggested next step:
1) 30-min pilot planning call to map success criteria and data access (I included a Calendly link below)
2) Lightweight PoC scope: 2-week small batch -> streaming inference against a sample feature stream

Pick a time here: https://calendly.com/vanessa_ortiz/redwood-pilot-planning-30

If this still looks like a match, I'd like to loop in Aditya (cc'd) to sketch the pilot and estimate run-rate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
